top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks are a well-bounded invention (Katori's magic-wavelength trapping, realised by Ye's group at 10^-18) that has been reproduced and intercompared across independent laboratories, so the achievement is mature and the two-laureate allocation and citation scope are defensible. Awarding it is clearly better than no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; optical clocks lie outside my superconducting-circuit and WACQT work
